title: Google Sign-In Domain Failure Forensic Trace
primaryRootCause: Vercel Production deployment bundle was built targeting the legacy Firebase project (promise-of-planet-youtube-api.firebaseapp.com) because VITE_FIREBASE_* environment variables were set only for Preview environments or built prior to configuration correction. Consequently, Firebase Auth verifies the origin against the legacy project where q-saudi-work-follow-app.vercel.app is not authorized.

rootCauseHierarchy.P1: Stale/Mismatched Production Build on Vercel pointing authDomain to promise-of-planet-youtube-api instead of gen-lang-client-0774589047.
rootCauseHierarchy.P2: Missing or incomplete Authorized Origins (https://q-saudi-work-follow-app.vercel.app) or Redirect URIs (https://gen-lang-client-0774589047.firebaseapp.com/__/auth/handler) in GCP OAuth 2.0 Web Client configuration.
rootCauseHierarchy.P3: Environment variable scoping in Vercel Dashboard (Production scope vs Preview scope).

minimumFix:
1. Configure VITE_FIREBASE_* environment variables in Vercel Dashboard explicitly for the Production environment targeting gen-lang-client-0774589047.
2. Trigger a clean Redeploy on Vercel without build cache.
3. Verify GCP Console OAuth Web Client Authorized Origins contains https://q-saudi-work-follow-app.vercel.app and Authorized Redirect URIs contains https://gen-lang-client-0774589047.firebaseapp.com/__/auth/handler.

explicitOutputs.PRIMARY_ROOT_CAUSE: Vercel Production deployment was compiled targeting legacy Firebase project (promise-of-planet-youtube-api.firebaseapp.com) due to Preview-only Vercel environment variable scoping or stale build cache.
explicitOutputs.MINIMUM_FIX: Set Production environment variables in Vercel to gen-lang-client-0774589047, clear Vercel build cache and redeploy, and ensure GCP OAuth Client Authorized Origins includes https://q-saudi-work-follow-app.vercel.app.
